title: Make interrupt message delivery send at most one Ctrl-C
description: Interrupt-priority delivery currently sends Ctrl-C even when the agent is already idle and retries Ctrl-C up to three times. That can terminate an idle Codex/Claude session. Check current state immediately before delivery: send no Ctrl-C when idle, send exactly one Ctrl-C when non-idle (including blocked/user-prompt states), wait once for idle, then deliver. Add regression coverage for idle, non-idle, blocked, timeout, raw, and SignalInterrupt behavior.

comments.author: fond-frost
comments.text: Implemented and self-reviewed: message.deliver now rechecks DeliveryConfig.IsIdle immediately before ETX, skips Ctrl-C/SignalInterrupt/WaitForIdle when idle, and sends exactly one Ctrl-C plus one idle wait when non-idle (including blocked states). Removed the three-attempt retry loop. Added regression tests for already-idle delivery, active-to-idle transition between dequeue and delivery, blocked timeout, exact single ETX, raw delivery, and SignalInterrupt counts. go test -race ./internal/session/message, go test ./internal/session/message ./internal/session, make check, and make test pass.
